_about: Hand-checked LIP rates for the estimator. Every number cites its FSA source. Change only from a newer FSA notice or the rule, and update review_by. The export copies this file to the site as data/rates.json and warns when review_by has passed.

2026.values_source: FSA Notice LIP-14, 8-3-26, par. 5 A: 2026 national average market values per head, beginning of the program year

unborn_check.source: FSA Notice LIP-14 par. 9 C table: Beef, Adult Cow, per head of eligible bred females lost after normal mortality

factors.source: 7 CFR 1416.306(b)-(d), (i)(3), (j) as amended 7/9/2026 (Federal Register doc. 2026-13878); FSA Notice LIP-14 par. 6 A, 7 D-E, 9 C

normal_mortality.source: FSA Handbook 1-LIP, amendment 9 (posted 9/22/2025), Exhibit 4, National Normal Mortality Rate Table (beef: non-adult under 400 lb 5%, 400 lb or more 5%, adult cow 1.5%, bull 1.5%)
normal_mortality.note: Each state FSA committee sets its own rates (1-LIP par. 4 A); the national table is the fallback. Add a state here only from that state's FSA office, with the date.

deadline: March 1 after the calendar year of the loss; the following Monday when March 1 falls on a Saturday or Sunday (2026 LIP fact sheet)
